categories.main_business_segments: Chaozhou Three-Circle (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic ceramic components industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of electronic components and advanced materials. Its main product lines include communication components, electronic components and materials, and new materials, serving sectors such as electronics, communication, consumer electronics, industrial electronic equipment, and new energy. The company also develops products for emerging fields like AI, data centers, automotive electronics, and bioceramics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 50 years of R&D experience in electronic ceramic components, mastering ceramic material preparation, forming, and sintering technologies, as well as precision mold design and manufacturing. It has achieved large-scale production of key products like MLCCs (multi-layer ceramic capacitors) and ceramic packaging bases. The firm emphasizes innovation in high-capacity MLCCs, solid oxide fuel cells (SOFC), bioceramic materials, and precision ceramic structural parts for the semiconductor industry, supported by multiple research institutes and advanced testing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in electronics, telecommunications, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial control, and new energy sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products applied in mobile smart terminals, data centers, AI, robotics, and biomedicine. Major end markets are industrial electronics, communication equipment, automotive electronics, and emerging strategic industries related to low-carbon and green technologies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guangdong Province and multiple subsidiaries across China including Shenzhen, Chengdu, Suzhou, and Deyang. It also has overseas subsidiaries and operations in Germany, the Netherlands, Malaysia, the United States, South Korea, India, Thailand, and Hong Kong, covering production, sales, and asset management activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chaozhou Three-Circle operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and development of electronic ceramic components and advanced materials. It supplies these components to downstream manufacturers in electronics, communications, automotive, and new energy industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and scale expansion to strengthen its core product competitiveness and market position. R&D focuses include enhancing MLCC technology, developing high-capacity automotive-grade MLCCs, advancing solid oxide fuel cells, bioceramic products, and precision ceramic parts for semiconductors. It is building regional research centers and integrating AI technologies to improve information management and production automation, aiming for sustainable, high-quality growth aligned with low-carbon and green industry trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electronic components and materials, including MLCCs, ceramic packaging bases, and advanced materials. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial asset management. Sales are conducted via direct product sales to industrial customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading domestic player with over 50 years of expertise and a growing international presence. It emphasizes its technological advantages, comprehensive product matrix, and expanding market share in MLCCs and advanced ceramic components to maintain competitiveness amid increasing industry competition and import substitution trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.37 billion, a 28.78% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2.19 billion, up 38.55%. It maintains a strong financial position with total assets nearing RMB 23.9 billion and equity of RMB 19.87 billion. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, profit, and cash flow, supported by increased R&D investment and expanding production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chaozhou Three-Circle emphasizes its deep technological expertise, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive product portfolio as key differentiators. It offers high-quality, reliable electronic ceramic components tailored for diverse applications including automotive, communication, and new energy sectors. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality improvement, and customer-centric product development, along with its integrated supply chain and advanced manufacturing processes, provide competitive advantages and sustainable value to customers.
